Do you like to be physically busy and do you prefer to work in a structured environment? In this position you ensure that orders are correctly and neatly packed and ready for shipment.

Sector

With your eye for detail and sense of responsibility, you will ensure that customers receive their orders complete and in perfect condition. 
You will work the day shift, including opportunities to work overtime. There is room for development, and your commitment is appreciated both on and off the shop floor.

 Job requirements 
What do you bring? - Experience in packing or production work is a plus; - Good command of the English language; - You work accurately and responsibly; - You are a team player with a flexible attitude; - You are motivated and eager to learn.

Sector 
 Wholesale
